about: Online features for Sound Shapes will no longer be playable from January 31, 2019 at 12:00 PM PT. Functionality will be affected in the following ways: o   You will be able to play the campaign and all DLC purchases as well as create your own levels.
o   You will not be able to share your levels with the community or download community created levels.
Now available on PS4™, PS3™, and PS Vita systems.

Part platformer, part music creator, Sound Shapes™ is the award winning & critically acclaimed game from Queasy Games (Everyday Shooter) that combines sight and sound into a truly unique gaming experience.

Play through albums by Beck, deadmau5, and Jim Guthrie all beautifully illustrated by artists from Capy (SUPER TIME FORCE, Might & Magic: COH), Pyramid Attack (Jabbawaki, Guitar Hero), and Superbrothers (Sword & Sworcery).
